data.notes: The report got the most important things right. It scopes the win to online memberships with the front desk still on Global, surfaces the Maya-chose/Greg-decided contradiction, and marks customer language as not covered. It misses some insight. The trigger section never links the board-level churn metric to why the controller cared. The rep takeaway skips 'treat the front desk as a live deal', and the message section asserts an unsupported aside about an 'M6 proven ROI' claim that never came up in the interview.
